title: Moneycontrol + Screener Stock Data Validator
description: Run the prefilled Reliance comparison to validate public Indian stock data across Moneycontrol and Screener.in. Get both source values, differences, agreement scores, and one normalized record without an API key.

symbols.title: NSE symbols or BSE codes
symbols.description: Ready to run with RELIANCE. Add symbols such as TCS, INFY, HDFCBANK, or a BSE code such as 500325.
symbols.sectionDescription: Ready to run as-is: compare one Reliance stock record across Moneycontrol and Screener.in.

maxResults.title: Maximum stocks
maxResults.description: Start with 1 to verify the comparison and cost. Increase only when you are ready to process more symbols.

source.title: Data sources
source.description: Compare both sources for validation, or use one source when you only need its published values.
source.sectionDescription: The recommended setup saves source values, metric differences, discrepancy flags, and an overall agreement score.

requireBothSources.title: Only save complete comparisons
requireBothSources.description: Keep enabled for validation work. The stock is saved only when both Moneycontrol and Screener.in return usable data.

comparisonTolerancePercent.title: Allowed difference (%)
comparisonTolerancePercent.description: A shared metric counts as matching when its symmetric percentage difference is at or below this tolerance.

consolidated.title: Use consolidated financials
consolidated.description: Use consolidated Screener.in values when available.
consolidated.sectionDescription: The core comparison is fast. Enable additional statements or ownership data only when your workflow needs them.

includeFinancials.title: Include quarterly and annual results
includeFinancials.description: Adds the latest four quarters and five annual summary periods from Screener.in.

includeShareholding.title: Include shareholding pattern
includeShareholding.description: Adds the latest promoter, FII, DII, and public holdings from Screener.in when available.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent stocks
maxConcurrency.description: Keep 1 for the sample. Use modest concurrency for larger runs to reduce source rate limiting.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Increase concurrency only after a successful one-stock comparison.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Direct requests are the cheapest verified default. Try Apify datacenter proxy only if either source begins blocking; residential traffic can cost more than the Actor fee.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: No proxy is required for the verified Reliance quick start.
